capability.purpose: Reproduce, minimize, explain, and correct a hard failure through a tight red-capable feedback loop.

use_when.text: A reported bug, regression, flake, or performance failure requires a red-capable feedback loop before causal commitment
The failure can be reproduced or a measurable signal can be constructed against the affected seam

do_not_use_when.text: The reported issue is a missing feature or enhancement with no failure to reproduce
Repository truth itself is the immediate blocker rather than the failure

inputs.name: failure_symptom
inputs.description: Observed bug, regression, flake, or performance failure to reproduce.

inputs.name: repository_scope
inputs.description: Code and execution surface in which the failure should be investigated.

inputs.name: known_evidence
inputs.description: Existing logs, traces, tests, requests, or prior hypotheses.

outputs.name: root_cause
outputs.description: Evidence-backed causal explanation or explicit statement of missing evidence.

outputs.name: regression_proof
outputs.description: Red-to-green regression evidence at the strongest useful public seam.

outputs.name: fix
outputs.description: Smallest correct implementation change when the cause is established.

preconditions.description: A signal capable of detecting the reported failure can be built or recovered.

requirements.description: The exact symptom is detected by a repeatable red-capable loop before causal commitment.
The minimized regression and original feedback loop pass after the fix.
Temporary instrumentation is removed and follow-up work is separated from the correctness fix.

evidence_outputs.name: diagnostic_report
evidence_outputs.description: Root cause, falsified alternatives, loop command or artifact, fix, and bounded follow-up.

evidence_outputs.name: regression_evidence
evidence_outputs.description: Inspectable red-to-green evidence for the reported failure.

compatibility.notes: Generic Diagnose defaults to local/workspace authority; provider-only or production diagnosis requires a specialized capability or explicit escalation.
